caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric with a beige background, featuring a symmetrical decorative pattern. The design includes large circular floral motifs in each corner of the square, created with a pinkish-red color. In the center, there is a prominent diamond-shaped motif outlined with blue patterns and filled with both pinkish-red and blue linear and leafy elements. The overall design is arranged symmetrically around the vertical and horizontal axes, with smaller cross-like details in pinkish-red scattered in the spaces between the central and corner motifs. The fabric appears to have a woven texture, and the colors are limited to the natural beige of the background, the pinkish-red, and blue. The artist's signature "Christoffels" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
